title: A shared first step for CPLX1 families and DEE-P Connections

sentences.text: We hope to build a family-led collaboration with DEE-P Connections (DEEP).
The atlas infers your SNAP25 community connection from a website link, not formal membership, with confidence 0.45—below 0.5.
CPLX1 and SNAP25 help nerve cells release chemical messages; published CPLX1 loss-of-function evidence remains limited.

sections.heading: What already exists that we could share

sentences.text: Potential starting points include RARE-X, CMDIR and Simons Searchlight for SNAP25; Citizen Health, ENDD Center, ESCO and the STXBP1 Foundation Grants Program for STXBP1; and Connect CDKL5.
Let us explore shared designs and expertise without assuming CPLX1 eligibility or funding.

sections.heading: What must be checked before we join forces

sentences.text: Confirm acceptance of related conditions and necessary registry adaptations.

Review symptom-record gaps: sudden unexpected death in epilepsy across comparisons; generalized tonic seizures and overlapping toes for STX1B/SNAP25; overlapping toes and poor head control for STXBP1.
Check whether sudden unexpected death in epilepsy and generalized tonic seizures occur in STX1B, rather than treating missing records as absence.
Request the full resource gap lists: SNAP25 has 18 further symptoms, STXBP1 15, and CDKL5 17.
Check differing mechanisms: proteins blocking working copies or becoming overactive, plus two further SNAP25 mechanisms, four STXBP1 mechanisms, and CDKL5 kinase activity.
Read both sides of the contested STX1B and SNAP25 loss-of-function evidence; CPLX1’s 'one working copy is insufficient' claim is atlas-inferred, unverified and below 0.5 confidence.
Check for a CPLX1 group and enrolling registry before establishing a family network.
Please help us invite STX1B families to co-draft one blank shared symptom-record template this month, marking uncertain overlaps for review.

Is there a dedicated CPLX1 patient organisation, an enrolling registry or natural history study, an enrolling interventional trial, or a documented animal or cell model with verified access in the atlas?
Dear DEE-P Connections team,
Please consider this family-led proposal.
Could you help us connect with STX1B families?
We propose drafting a shared symptom-record template this month.
We would welcome your guidance on checking eligibility and differences before proceeding.
[Your name], on behalf of families affected by CPLX1-related disorders
